parameters.name: MachineTypes
parameters.description:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

*   Set the value to **ecs**, which specifies to query all Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

parameters.name: SupportAutoTag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the keyword that you specify for fuzzy search can be automatically matched. Default value: **false**. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The keyword that you specify for fuzzy search when you query the asset.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-criteria --machine-types ecs --value 47.96 --support-auto-tag true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeCriteria --region cn-hangzhou --SupportAutoTag true --MachineTypes ecs --Value '47.96'
